title: Database Engineering
description: Database challenges: schema design, query optimization, transactions, indexing, migrations, and advanced SQL features for SQLite and PostgreSQL

problems.title: Schema Design and Migrations
problems.description: Design a normalized schema for an e-commerce system and implement safe migrations with rollback capability.
requirements: Create normalized schema (3NF) for users, products, orders, order_items
Implement migration system with version tracking
Support forward and rollback migrations
Add appropriate indexes for common queries
Handle foreign key constraints properly
Include audit columns (created_at, updated_at)

test_cases.expected: Schema created then cleanly removed
Foreign key constraint violation

problems.title: Query Optimization with EXPLAIN
problems.description: Analyze and optimize slow queries using EXPLAIN ANALYZE. Identify missing indexes and rewrite inefficient queries.
requirements: Analyze query execution plans
Identify sequential scans that should be index scans
Rewrite subqueries as JOINs where beneficial
Use covering indexes for frequently accessed columns
Optimize ORDER BY with proper index ordering
Handle large result sets with pagination

test_cases.expected: Optimized to use JOIN, 10x+ improvement
Suggest trigram index or full-text search

problems.title: Transaction Isolation and Deadlock Handling
problems.description: Implement transaction management with proper isolation levels and deadlock detection/recovery.
requirements: Demonstrate READ COMMITTED vs SERIALIZABLE behavior
Implement optimistic locking with version columns
Detect and handle deadlocks gracefully
Use advisory locks for application-level locking
Implement retry logic with exponential backoff
Handle phantom reads in concurrent scenarios

test_cases.input: Two concurrent transactions updating same row
test_cases.expected: One succeeds, one retries or fails gracefully
Deadlock detected, one transaction rolled back

problems.title: Advanced Joins and Aggregations
problems.description: Write complex queries using various JOIN types, GROUP BY, HAVING, and aggregation functions.
requirements: Use INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, FULL OUTER joins appropriately
Implement self-joins for hierarchical data
Use GROUP BY with HAVING for filtered aggregations
Apply aggregate functions (SUM, AVG, COUNT, MAX, MIN)
Handle NULL values in aggregations correctly
Use DISTINCT and GROUP BY efficiently

test_cases.input: Find customers who spent more than average
test_cases.expected: Correct use of subquery or CTE with aggregation
Use LEFT JOIN with NULL check or NOT EXISTS

problems.title: Window Functions and Analytics
problems.description: Use window functions for running totals, rankings, and moving averages.
requirements: Implement ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK
Calculate running totals with SUM OVER
Compute moving averages with window frames
Use LAG/LEAD for row comparisons
Partition results with PARTITION BY
Implement FIRST_VALUE/LAST_VALUE correctly

test_cases.expected: Correct window frame: ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW

test_cases.input: Rank products by sales within each category
test_cases.expected: Use RANK() with PARTITION BY category

evaluation_criteria.frames: Proper use of window frame specifications

problems.title: Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and Recursion
problems.description: Use CTEs for readable queries and recursive CTEs for hierarchical data traversal.
requirements: Refactor complex queries using CTEs
Implement recursive CTE for tree traversal
Handle cycles in recursive queries
Use multiple CTEs in single query
Implement path enumeration for hierarchies
Calculate tree depth and level

test_cases.input: Find all descendants of a node in org chart
test_cases.expected: Recursive CTE returning full subtree
Path like 'Electronics > Computers > Laptops'

problems.title: Full-Text Search Implementation
problems.description: Implement full-text search with ranking, stemming, and phrase matching.
requirements: Create full-text search indexes (FTS5 for SQLite, tsvector for PostgreSQL)
Implement ranked search results
Support phrase and proximity searches
Handle stemming and stop words
Implement search suggestions/autocomplete
Highlight search matches in results

test_cases.expected: Returns ranked results, 'run' matches 'running'
Only matches exact phrase, not individual words

problems.title: JSON Operations and Document Storage
problems.description: Store and query JSON data efficiently using native JSON functions.
requirements: Store JSON documents in appropriate column types
Extract values from JSON using path expressions
Create indexes on JSON fields
Update nested JSON values
Aggregate over JSON arrays
Convert between JSON and relational formats

test_cases.expected: Uses index on JSON path if available

test_cases.input: Aggregate tags from JSON array across products
test_cases.expected: Correct use of json_each/jsonb_array_elements

evaluation_criteria.indexing: JSON paths can be indexed and queried efficiently

problems.title: Connection Pooling and Resource Management
problems.description: Implement connection pooling with proper resource cleanup and connection lifecycle management.
requirements: Create connection pool with min/max connections
Implement connection health checks
Handle connection timeouts gracefully
Implement connection recycling
Track connection metrics (active, idle, wait time)
Clean up connections on shutdown

test_cases.expected: Requests queue and complete without connection exhaustion
Pool validates and replaces stale connection

problems.title: Database Testing and Fixtures
problems.description: Write database tests with proper fixtures, isolation, and cleanup.
requirements: Create reusable test fixtures
Isolate tests with transactions (rollback after each)
Test constraint violations
Test trigger behavior
Mock/stub database for unit tests
Use factories for test data generation

test_cases.expected: All tests isolated, no interference
Related records deleted, constraint enforced
